urgency.instructions: How urgent is this, judged only by severity and whether a workaround exists? Do not consider how many people are affected. 5 = urgent/critical, 1 = low priority.
criteria: 1 - Very low: informational or cosmetic, nothing is broken
2 - Low: minor issue, easy workaround, no deadline
3 - Medium: real disruption, workaround exists, can wait a few hours
4 - High: workaround exists but is painful or costly, needs prompt attention
5 - Urgent/Critical: no workaround exists, work is fully blocked, needs immediate action

impact.instructions: How wide is the impact? 5 = business-wide or customer-facing outage, 1 = a single user's machine.
criteria: 2 - A few users or one small team
3 - One department or a moderate-sized group
4 - Multiple departments / large part of the business
5 - Business-wide or customer-facing: company-critical, many or all staff affected
